entries.name: Jury-Rigger
entries.rule_summary: Engineering may create a temporary period-plausible substitute from available materials when physically feasible.

entries.name: Fine Motor Stabilizer
entries.rule_summary: Ignore ordinary tremor, vibration, or stress instability during trained precision manual work.

entries.name: Rapid Triage
entries.rule_summary: Stabilize an adjacent living target for 1 AP instead of 2 AP when using Medicine and appropriate gear.

entries.name: Chronometric Focus
entries.rule_summary: Track several short intervals, sequences, or timed events with implant-grade precision; interpretation still uses the relevant Skill.

entries.name: Field Fabrication
entries.rule_summary: A successful Engineering improvisation may produce a robust temporary device lasting an operation when materials, tools, and design permit.

entries.name: Diagnostic Overlay
entries.rule_summary: After one Observe/diagnostic action, ask for the most immediate visible failure point in a system you can directly examine.

entries.name: Sterile Field
entries.rule_summary: In improvised but controllable conditions, ordinary contamination alone does not impose Disadvantage on Medicine procedures.

entries.name: Systems Bridge
entries.rule_summary: Interface two otherwise incompatible but understandable systems long enough to exchange one bounded signal, control, measurement, or data set when a bridge is possible.

entries.name: Parallel Procedure
entries.rule_summary: Maintain one ongoing technical/medical process while performing a second related task without ordinary minor distraction penalties.

entries.name: Technical Mastery Kernel
entries.rule_summary: Qualifying hands-on technical rolls in the Mastered domain include the Skill Mastery Die.

entries.name: Clinical Mastery Kernel
entries.rule_summary: Qualifying clinical rolls in the Mastered domain include the Skill Mastery Die.

entries.name: Adaptive Fabrication Model
entries.rule_summary: Once per scene after examining a failed or unavailable component, identify a plausible substitute architecture; a successful task may build it if suitable materials and time exist.

entries.name: Trauma Orchestration
entries.rule_summary: When treating multiple casualties, a successful Medicine action may allow the next linked ally's immediate Medicine/Recovery action on another target to add d6 as a VAM die.

entries.name: Restoration Synthesis
entries.rule_summary: Once per mission, make a Mastery-enabled roll to identify a sequence that preserves the most critical function in a complex failing system, structure, device, or patient.
